# OSPFv2 (`ospfv2`)

- **Layer**: L3 (network)
- **Header**: 24 octets (fixed)
- **Notes**: [Routing protocols](../../protocols/routing.md)

## Reached from

| Lower layer | Selector | Value |
|---|---|---|
| [`ipv4`](ipv4.md) | `protocol` | 89 (0x59) |

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Auto | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `version` | `uint(8)` | `2` |   | OSPF version (2 = OSPFv2, 3 = OSPFv3). |
| `type` | `enum(8)` | `1` (hello) | Protocol number of the next layer (see Next layer) | OSPF packet type (Hello / DB Description / LS Request / LS Update / LS Ack; Auto from the next layer). |
| `packet_length` | `uint(16)` |   | Length of the header and payload in octets | Length of the OSPF packet including the header, in octets (Auto). |
| `router_id` | `ipv4` | `192.0.2.1` |   | Router ID of the sending router. |
| `area_id` | `ipv4` | `0.0.0.0` |   | Area the packet belongs to (0.0.0.0 = backbone). |
| `checksum` | `uint(16)` |   | Internet checksum over the header and everything after it; `authentication` counted as zero | Internet checksum over the OSPF packet without the authentication field (Auto). |
| `au_type` | `enum(16)` | `0` (null) |   | Authentication type (0 = null, 1 = simple password, 2 = cryptographic). |
| `authentication` | `bytes(8)` | `00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00` |   | 64-bit authentication field (password, or key id / sequence for cryptographic auth). |

### `type`

| Value | Name |
|---|---|
| 1 (0x01) | `hello` |
| 2 (0x02) | `db_description` |
| 3 (0x03) | `ls_request` |
| 4 (0x04) | `ls_update` |
| 5 (0x05) | `ls_ack` |

### `au_type`

| Value | Name |
|---|---|
| 0 (0x0000) | `null` |
| 1 (0x0001) | `simple_password` |
| 2 (0x0002) | `cryptographic` |

## Next layer

The next layer is selected by `type`; when the field is Auto the builder writes the value of the protocol stacked above.

| Value | Protocol | Note |
|---|---|---|
| 1 (0x01) | [`ospfv2_hello`](ospfv2_hello.md) |   |
| 2 (0x02) | [`ospfv2_dbd`](ospfv2_dbd.md) |   |
| 3 (0x03) | [`ospfv2_lsr`](ospfv2_lsr.md) |   |
| 4 (0x04) | [`ospfv2_lsu`](ospfv2_lsu.md) |   |
| 5 (0x05) | [`ospfv2_lsack`](ospfv2_lsack.md) |   |
